blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — Anti-narcotics operatives seized P714,000 worth of suspected shabu and arrested an alleged “high-value” drug personality in a late-night sting in Barangay 35 here on Thursday. The suspect, identified only by the alias “Atang,” 42, was arrested at around 10:35 p.m. during a joint buy-bust operation, the Police Regional Office-10 (PRO-10) stated in a press advisory on Friday. Maj. Joann Navarro, PRO-10 spokesperson, told the Inquirer that members of the Regional Police Drug Enforcement Unit (RPDEU) Team 1 spearheaded the operation, backed by various local police units, intelligence teams, and the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA-10).
